'''Fubini''' was<ref name="TOR" /> a [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was affiliated with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> they worked as a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] inside the [[Dromund Kaas spaceport|spaceport]] located near the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Kaas City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. While stationed at the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], Fubini wore [[Color/Legends|gray-colored]] [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] and sold [[Armor/Legends|armor]] from a stall. They had brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]], blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and light skin.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fubini appeared as an Imperial armor vendor in the spaceport on the planet Dromund Kaas in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] produced by [[BioWare]].<ref name="TOR" />
